ValidationRule.description: Validates that the Close Date of an opportunity is not within a month prior to the current month.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Validation_Rules__c && NOT($Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Executing__c) && AND( OR ( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED( TSGADX__Close_Date__c )), TSGADX__Close_Date__c < DATE( YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date cannot be prior to current month.
